items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: He was unheard of. I remember as a kid where he used to be on the corner, sat on the corner and preach.

ctx.x: And the same thing with Jelly Roll Morton. He was unheard of. I remember as a kid where he used to be on the corner, sat on the corner and preach.
When you say preach, what do you mean?
